Reserve a free slot (a wallet that is a Perpl account)
Pay AUSD to the slot wallet, signed by your Privy wallet
The slot deposits it into Perpl (depositCollateral)
Place a market order on Perpl’s API at your leverage;
Perpl forwards it on-chain, we confirm the fill with getPosition
Mint the position token; the contract checks it against Perpl
Create the token’s isolated lending pool
Deposit your tokens as collateral, then borrow
The pool values them live from the token
AUSD is drawn from the vault to your wallet
Repay any time. If a loan becomes unhealthy,
You allow Laxu to repay and nothing else: a Privy signer
with a policy, plus an exact AUSD allowance. The backend

Privy checks the policy. A capped repay lands on the pool;
transfers, other pools and over-cap calls are refused.
